name: vwap_i2_tp_1_s40

source.title: VWAP hunt 2026-10-20 (owner's brief, idea 2): A pullback inside a trend that holds above its day-average price is a dip the trend's buyers take. Who loses: the sellers of the first red bar of an up day.

entry.words: Above a rising 09:30 VWAP and up at least 0.1 % over the last 60 minutes, the first down bar -> market long (mirror short); entries 10:30-15:30, at most 4 trades and no entry after 2 losers in a pass. stop 40 / target 60 points; at most 4 a pass; flat 15:58.

taught: [owner 2026-10-20, brief prompt-vwap-5-10-a-day-3to1-blocks, idea 2] Above a rising 09:30 VWAP and up at least 0.1 % over the last 60 minutes, the first down bar -> market long (mirror short); entries 10:30-15:30, at most 4 trades and no entry after 2 losers in a pass.

[owner 2026-10-20, brief section 3] versions: bars 1 / 5 / 15, NY cash and London / overnight where the family runs, stops 25 / 30 / 40 and a structure stop, target 1.5 x the stop: this sheet is bars 1, stop 40 / target 60 points
not_run: PRE-REGISTERED in out/vwap_hunt_2026-10-20/PREREG.md before any run; nothing tuned on a result.
1-MINUTE SHEETS run the New York passes only (machine time); 5 / 15-minute sheets every pass the family runs except pre (08:25-09:30), which the brief does not ask for.
THE SESSION VWAP of the engine restarts at every pass start (09:30, 11:00, 13:30; 03:00 London; 00:00 Asia; 18:00 evening); 'rth' / 'us' anchors stay at 09:30 for the New York passes.
THE CAP: 4 trades per session pass (several passes: a day can hold more, and a trade of one pass may still be open when the next pass enters).
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS are read only by `bp.py taught wf` (the 3:1 block walk-forward, once), its output sent to a log unread until SELECTION.md is written.
